title: Coast Guard assists Sitka Mountain Rescue to hoist injured hiker on Baranof Island, Alaska
description: An MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew from Coast Guard Air Station Sitka hoists two hikers from Mount Bassie on Baranof Island, Alaska, Aug. 2, 2019. The husband and wife had been hiking the Cross Island Trail when the man reportedly fell approximately 150 feet, injured his face and hands and was finding it difficult to walk. U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station Sitka.
